MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The sealed wire connectors and heat shrink tubing complement my existing wire terminals by helping me join, insulate, and protect wiring during repairs.",
    "The outdoor Gorilla tape fits my repeated purchases of Gorilla tape and offers protection for repairs exposed to weather."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The screws, nuts, magnets, and cutting wheels require a particular project, fit, or tool that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Buying vinyl cement does not mean I need woodworking adhesives; the large thin-glue refill and colored wood filler serve different materials and tasks.",
    "Electronic cleaner is loosely related to my electrical supplies, but needing wire connections does not establish a need to clean electronics."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when I have no task for it.",
    "My adhesive purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in other glues without enough attention to their material, purpose, or quantity."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Supplies that work with tools and materials I already own feel more useful than items that assume an unrelated project.",
    "Exact dimensions, thread sizes, material compatibility, and package quantities matter before I would choose specialized repair supplies.",
    "My repeated Gorilla tape purchases provide a clearer reason for another tape option than a single vinyl cement purchase provides for woodworking glue."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair needs but extended them too broadly into specialized supplies without evidence of a matching task."
}
